# SimpleAccess Design System

> SimpleAccess Design System (simpleaccess-ds) is a lean, WCAG 2.2 AA multi-sensory design system built on Scalable and Modular Architecture for CSS (SMACSS), Atomic Design, and W3C DTCG 2025.10 tokens. It powers https://simpleaccess.io/ and is engineered for dual consumption by human developers and autonomous AI coding agents.

## Core Philosophy
- Web as Dynamic Document First: Clean semantic HTML5, zero unnecessary div bloat.
- Universal Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA): 14.3:1+ contrast, visible focus, 44px touch targets.
- Multi-Sensory Delight: Sight (contrast, dark mode, high contrast), Sound (screen reader clarity + Web Audio earcons), Touch (44px target sizes + tactile haptics).
- Educational Source Code: Markup includes insightful comments explaining the *why* of accessibility choices for "View Source" learning.

## Core Architecture
- Design Tokens: W3C DTCG 2025.10 standard in `tokens.json`.
- SMACSS Layering:
  - 01-base: CSS reset, typography, native HTML element styling, focus-visible indicators.
  - 02-layout: Major structural landmarks (`.l-header`, `.l-nav`, `.l-main`, `.l-container`, `.l-grid`, `.l-footer`).
  - 03-module: Self-contained components (`.m-skip-link`, `.m-nav-list`, `.m-nav-link`, `.m-hero`, `.m-card`, `.m-btn`, `.m-test-suite`, `.m-table`, `.m-demo`, `.m-badge`).
  - 04-state: Interactive states (`.is-current`, `[aria-current="page"]`, `.is-active`, `.is-disabled`).
  - 05-theme: Dark mode, Windows High Contrast Mode (`forced-colors`), and reduced motion.
- Web Components: Native Custom Elements (`<ds-header>`, `<ds-nav>`, `<ds-footer>`) implemented in Light DOM to preserve semantic landmark hierarchy for screen readers.

## Multi-Sensory Standards
- Sight:
  - Background canvas: `#f4f4f4` (Light) / `#0a192f` (Dark)
  - Surface: `#ffffff` (Light) / `#132238` (Dark)
  - Text: `#1a1a1a` (Light, 15.5:1 on canvas) / `#f0f4f8` (Dark)
  - Brand Navy: `#002d62` (14.3:1 on white)
  - Accent Gold: `#ffd700` (9.5:1 on navy)
  - Focus Ring: `#d4af37` (3px solid with 3px offset)
- Sound:
  - Accessible Screen Reader Landmarks: `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`
  - Audio Earcons: `playEarcon(freq, duration)` via Web Audio API (default 440Hz sine pulse with exponential decay). Muted automatically when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active.
- Touch:
  - Target Size: 44x44px minimum for all interactive controls (exceeds WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 24px requirement).
  - Tactile Haptics: `triggerHaptic(duration)` via `navigator.vibrate` (12ms tactile tick on touch devices).

## Web Components
- `<ds-header title="..." tagline="..." subpage="true|false"></ds-header>`:
  - Renders `<header class="l-header">`. If `subpage="true"`, heading is an educational backlink so the page's H1 belongs in `<main>`.
- `<ds-nav></ds-nav>`:
  - Renders `<nav class="l-nav" aria-label="Global Sections">` with links to Home, WCAG Principles, Screen Readers, MS Office, Adobe PDF, Sensory Lab, HTML Elements, and Making Of. Automatically resolves and marks `aria-current="page"` and `.is-current` using `window.location.pathname`.
- `<ds-footer></ds-footer>`:
  - Renders `<footer class="l-footer">` with copyright and standards notice.

## Templates
- Home Template: `templates/home.template.html`
- HTML Element Reference: `templates/element.template.html`
- Topic Guide: `templates/guide.template.html`
- Sensory Lab: `templates/lab.template.html`

## Agentic Workflow Guidance
- Zero Hallucinations: When refactoring pages, use ONLY the CSS classes defined in `css/simpleaccess.css`. Do not invent new class prefixes or inline styles.
- Standard Shell: Every page links `/assets/ds/simpleaccess.css` and `/assets/ds/simpleaccess.js`.
- Landmark Integrity: Include `<a href="#main-content" class="m-skip-link">Skip to main content</a>` before `<ds-header>`.
- Sensory Lab Rule: In `sensory-lab/*/inaccessible/` subpages, DO NOT fix the intentional accessibility barrier markup. Refactor only the outer header/nav/footer chrome.
